The commodity which I longed for, that I have found in the Love of Lord's Name.
ACNX: There are so many pleasures and delights of Maya, but they pass away in an instant.

Yours saints are imbued with Your Name, and they enjoy peace at all the places.

The entire world is seen passing away, but ever stable is God's Name.

Make you friendship with the saint, that you mayest obtain an eternal abode.

Friends, intimates, sons and relations, none shall be a companion of yours.

Lord's Name alone is the mortals partisan, and Lord is the Master of the meek.

Lord's lotus feet are the ship and getting attached with them, I have crossed the world ocean.
26HD: Meeting with the Perfect True Guru, I embrace True Love for God. ||6||
Meeting the perfect True Guru, I have come to embrace true love with the Lord.

Your saints prayer is, "O Lord, forget me not even for the duration of a breath, and a morsel".
7ZG2: Whatever is pleasing to Your Will is good; by Your Sweet Will, my affairs are adjusted. ||7||
Whatever pleases You O God, that is good. By Yours will the affairs are adjusted.
T1GQ: I have met my Beloved, the Ocean of Peace, and Supreme Bliss has welled up within me.
I have met my Beloved, the ocean of peace, and in me has accrued the Supreme bliss.
AK5U: Says Nanak, all my pains have been eradicated, meeting with God, the Lord of Supreme Bliss. ||8||1||2||

There is but one God. By True Guru's grace. He is obtained to.

Contemplate on the Supreme Lord Master and be a sacrifice to His sight, O my dear.

How can He be forsaken, O dear, by remembering whom sorrow are forgotten?

O dear, I would sell this body to the saint, if he causes me to meet my Beloved.

The pleasures and decoration of sin are futile and I have forsaken and abandoned them, O Mother.

Lust, wrath and avarice forsook me O dear when I fell at the feet of the True Guru.
2N3H: Those humble beings who are imbued with the Lord, O Beloved, do not go anywhere else. ||6||
The persons, who are imbued with the Lord, O dear, go not anywhere else.
A85D: Those who have tasted the Lord's sublime essence, O Beloved, remain satisfied and satiated. ||7||
They who have tasted God's essence, O dear, remain satiated and sated.
CMEM: One who grasps the Hem of the Gown of the Holy Saint, O Nanak, crosses over the terrible world-ocean. ||8||1||3||
He, who seizes the skirt of the saint, O Nanak, crosses over the terrible world ocean.
4T5B: The pains of birth and death are removed, O Beloved, when the mortal meets with the Lord, the King. ||1||
The pain of birth and death is removed, O dear, when man meets God, the King.
T7MM: God is so Beautiful, so Refined, so Wise - He is my very life! Reveal to me Your Darshan! ||2||
The beauteous, accomplished and Omniscient Lord is my very life. Show me Your vision, O Master.
ALZV: Those beings who are separated from You, O Beloved, are born only to die; they eat the poison of corruption. ||3||
The mortals who are separated from You, O my Beloved, are born only to die and eat the poison of sins.
TRHS: He alone meets You, whom You cause to meet, O Beloved; I fall at his feet. ||4||
He alone meets You, O my Love, whom You causes to meet. I fall at his feet.
CPPA: That happiness which one receives by beholding Your Darshan, O Beloved, cannot be described in words. ||5||
The happiness, man receives by seeing the sight of the Beloved cannot be told by mouth.
H6R2: True Love cannot be broken, O Beloved; throughout the ages, it remains. ||6||
The true love of the Beloved snaps not. It lasts all the ages through.

F8UL: Whatever pleases You is good, O Beloved; Your Will is Eternal. ||7||
Whatever pleases You, that is good, O Love, Eternal is Your will.
D5TV: Nanak, those who are imbued with the Love of the All-Pervading Lord, O Beloved, remain intoxicated with His Love, in natural ease. ||8||2||4||
Nanak, who are imbued with the love of the All-pervading-Lord, they remain instinctively inebriated, O dear.
L1PN: You know all about my condition, O Beloved; who can I speak to about it? ||1||
You knowest all the condition of mine, O Love. To whom should I tell and narrate it?
BAQ9: You are the Giver of all beings; they eat and wear what You give them. ||2||
You are the Giver of all the beings they eat and wear what You givest them.
PYT5: Pleasure and pain come by Your Will, O Beloved; they do not come from any other. ||3||
Weal and woe are in They, will, O Beloved There is not another from where they emanate.
D1C3: Whatever You cause me to do, that I do, O Beloved; I cannot do anything else. ||4||
My Beloved, what You causes me to do, that alone I do Anything else I cannot do.
6694: All my days and nights are blessed, O Beloved, when I chant and meditate on the Lord's Name. ||5||
Embellished are all the days and nights, O my Love, when God's Name is remembered.
7B9A: He does the deeds, O Beloved, which are pre-ordained, and inscribed upon his forehead. ||6||
The mortal does the deeds, which are pre-ordained on his forehead, O my dear.
4GTT: The One is Himself prevailing everywhere, O Beloved; He is pervading in each and every heart. ||7||
The One Lord Himself is pervading every where, O my dear, in every Heart he is contained.

They, who perform service and practise truth, obtain the fruit.

R7FM: One who recognizes the One Lord among all beings does not talk of ego. ||4||
If anyone knows the One Lord among all the beings, he talks not of ego, then.
Q0QM: Kakka: When the hair grows grey, then it shines without shampoo.
K:-When the hair grow grey they shine without soap.
EU5F: The hunters of the King of Death come, and bind him in the chains of Maya. ||5||
Death-King's hunters come and they blind with the chain of mammon.
70Y4: Khakha: The Creator is the King of the world; He enslaves by giving nourishment.
Kh:-- The Creator is the King of the world, who gives sustenance man on enslaving him.

Under his command the entire world is bound and another's order pre avails not.

The Lord, who has shaped the pots and make the world kiln, decides the time to put them therein.
JNK1: Ghagha: The servant who performs service, remains attached to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

HUNN: One who recognizes bad and good as one and the same - in this way he is absorbed into the Lord and Master. ||8||
He who deems bad and good as the same, He in this way gets absorbed in the Lord.
W02Q: Chacha: He created the four Vedas, the four sources of creation, and the four ages
Ch:-- He, who made the four Vedas, four production-sources, and the four ages,
79U3: - through each and every age, He Himself has been the Yogi, the enjoyer, the Pandit and the scholar. ||9||
has Himself been, in all the ages the Renuciatior, the Reveller of the production sources and the learned scholar.

Having created doubt, You Yourself strayest the men and they, on whom is Yours grace, them the Guru's meets,
U72X: Jajja: That humble being who begs for wisdom has wandered begging through 8.4 million incarnations.

3EZH: The One Lord takes away, and the One Lord gives; I have not heard of any other. ||11||
The One Lord takes away, and the one Lord gives, I have heard not of another second.

Jh:-- Why die of anxiety, O mortal? What God has to give, that He continues to give.
JGWA: He gives, and gives, and watches over us; according to the Orders which He issues, His beings receive nourishment. ||12||
He gives, beholds, and issues orders according as the beings are to obtain sustenance.
4YBM: Nyanya: When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then I do not behold any other.
N:-- When I cast glance, I see not another. The One Lord pervades all the places,
H15S: The One Lord is totally pervading everywhere; the One Lord abides within the mind. ||13||
and The same One Lord dwells in the mind.
3MQ0: Tatta: Why do you practice hypocrisy, O mortal? In a moment, in an instant, you shall have to get up and depart.
T:-- Why practisest you deceit O mortal? You shall get up and depart in a moment and trice.
Z2NK: Don't lose your life in the gamble - hurry to the Lord's Sanctuary. ||14||
Lose not your play of life in gamble. Do you run and fall under God's protection.
UH79: T'hat'ha: Peace pervades within those who link their consciousness to the Lord's Lotus Feet.

8BMV: Those humble beings, whose consciousness is so linked, are saved; by Your Grace, they obtain peace. ||15||

CM4U: So serve Him, who is contained and pervading among everyone, and you shall obtain peace. ||16||
Serve Him, who is contained among all Only then shall you obtain peace.

Creating the creation He beholds it He issues commands, and emancipates him, on whom He casts His merciful glance.
X1NH: Nanna: One whose heart is filled with the Lord, sings His Glorious Praises.
N:-- He, within whose mind pervades the Lord, sings God's praise.
F6N6: One whom the Creator Lord unites with Himself, is not consigned to reincarnation. ||18||
He, whom the Creator unites with His ownself, is not born again.

I have no boat, nor any raft. I am drowning, Save me, O my Saviour King.

MHQJ: What is doubt? What is called Maya? Whatever pleases Him is good. ||20||
What is doubt? What is called mammon? Whatever pleases Him, that is good.
1VQ9: Dadda: Do not blame anyone else; blame instead your own actions.

MU9Q: Whatever I did, for that I have suffered; I do not blame anyone else. ||21||
Whatever I did, for that I have suffered, I blame no one else.
SGVQ: Dhadha: His power established and upholds the earth; the Lord has imparted His color to everything.

QC6K: His gifts are received by everyone; all act according to His Command. ||22||
whose gifts', everyone receives, His will works according to mortals deeds.
AVVZ: Nanna: The Husband Lord enjoys eternal pleasures, but He is not seen or understood.

BSTZ: I am called the happy soul-bride, O sister, but my Husband Lord has never met me. ||23||
Undoubtedly I am called the wife, but my Groom has never met me, O my sister.
5US6: Pappa: The Supreme King, the Transcendent Lord, created the world, and watches over it.
P:-- The Transcendent Lord our King, has made the world to behold.
RMS4: He sees and understands, and knows everything; inwardly and outwardly, he is fully pervading. ||24||
He sees, understands and knows everything. Within and without He is pervading.
J8Y7: Faffa: The whole world is caught in the noose of Death, and all are bound by its chains.

H4C0: By Guru's Grace, they alone are saved, who hurry to enter the Lord's Sanctuary. ||25||
Only those persons are saved who by Guru's grace run and enter God's sanctuary.
7K67: Babba: He set out to play the game, on the chess-board of the four ages.

He made all the men and other beings His draughtmen, and Himself began to through the dice.

As long as there is breath in the body, he reads of other things and forgets the letter M, death and God.
Q0U3: Yaya: He is never reincarnated again, if he recognizes the True Lord.

The Guru-ward utters, the Guru-ward understands, and the Guru-ward knows but one God.
SPDV: Rarra: The Lord is contained among all; He created all beings.

2V8W: Having created His beings, He has put them all to work; they alone remember the Naam, upon whom He bestows His Grace. ||30||
Having created the beings, He has put them all to work they, on whom is His grace, remember His Name.

32XQ: We eat and drink; we should endure equally whatever occurs, by His Will, by His Command. ||31||
The Lord gives to eat and drink. Whatever befalls man under His will and command, he should endure it as alike.
22KD: Wawa: The all-pervading Transcendent Lord beholds the world; He created the form it wears.

M38J: He beholds, tastes, and knows everything; He is pervading and permeating inwardly and outwardly. ||32||
He (God), sees, tastes, and knows everything and is pervading within and without.
5M55: Haha: There is no other Giver than Him; having created the creatures, He gives them nourishment.
H:-- There is no other Giver than He, who on creating the creatures gives them sustenance.
1YE5: Meditate on the Lord's Name, be absorbed into the Lord's Name, and night and day, reap the Profit of the Lord's Name. ||34||
Meditate on God's Name, be absorbed in God's Name, and night and day derive you the profit of God's Name
JK63: Airaa: He Himself created the world; whatever He has to do, He continues to do.
A:-- What God, who Himself made the world, has to do, that He continues to do.
BK5P: He acts, and causes others to act, and He knows everything; so says Nanak, the poet. ||35||1||
The Lord acts and causes other to act, He knows everything and Like this says Nanak, the poet Asa Measure 3rd Guru.

There is but one God. By true Guru's grace He is obtained.
VGC0: Ayo, Angai: The whole world which was created - Kaahkai, Ghangai: It shall pass away.

YVJN: O mortal, why have you studied such an account,
O my soul why hasty you learnt such an account,
A2YY: which shall call you to answer for payment? ||1||Pause||
by which rendering of account still remains due from you? Pause.
9J03: Sidhan, Ngaayiyai: You do not remember the Lord. Nanna: You do not take the Lord's Name.
Sidhan Naiain. You O man, rememberest not God. N: --- Neither you takest the Name.

BBKZ: Babba: You do not understand, you fool; deluded by doubt, you are wasting your life.

NAA4: Without justification, you call yourself a teacher; thus you take on the loads of others. ||3||
Without cause you callest yourself a teacher, and takest on you the load of others.
WLTJ: Jajja: You have been robbed of your Light, you fool; in the end, you shall have to depart, and you shall regret and repent.

688X: You have not remembered the One Word of the Shabad, and so you shall have to enter the womb over and over again. ||4||
The one Lord you rememberest not, so you shall enter the womb, again and again.
9B8Z: Read that which is written on your forehead, O Pandit, and do not teach wickedness to others.
Red you that what is written on your forehead, O scholar and teach not wickedness to others.

To begin with the teacher is roped, and afterward the noose is put around the pupil neck.
6F65: Sassa: You have lost your self-discipline, you fool, and you have accepted an offering under false pretenses.
S:-- You have lost self discipline, O stupid and you have taken an improper charity.
62PJ: The daughter of the alms-giver is just like your own; by accepting this payment for performing the wedding ceremony, you have cursed your own life. ||6||
As is the daughter of your almsgiver, so is the yours. By taking this payment (for performing wedding ceremony } you have wasted your life.
FKZ2: Mamma: You have been cheated out your intellect, you fool, and you are afflicted with the great disease of ego.
M:-- You have been denuded of your intellect, O fool, and art infested with the great malady of self-conceit.
HT3V: Within your innermost self, you do not recognize God, and you compromise yourself for the sake of Maya. ||7||
Within your mind, you seest not the Lord and demeanest yourself for wealth.
3KB0: Kakka: You wander around in sexual desire and anger, you fool; attached to possessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.

QKXH: You read, and reflect, and proclaim out loud, but without understanding, you are drowned to death. ||8||
You readest reflectest and proclaimest much, but without knowing, you are drowned to death.
YUW1: Tatta: In anger, you are burnt, you fool. T'hat'ha: That place where you live, is cursed.

5XHR: Ghagha: You go begging from door to door, you fool. Dadda: But still, you do not receive the gift. ||9||
Gh:-- You beggest from door to door, O fool. D:-- You receivest not the Name's gift.
1ZUM: Pappa: You shall not be able to swim across, you fool, since you are engrossed in worldly affairs.

KGKZ: The True Lord Himself has ruined you, you fool; this is the destiny written on your forehead. ||10||
The True Lord has Himself beguiled you, O fool. It was so ordained on your brow.
HAW9: Bhabha: You have drowned in the terrifying world-ocean, you fool, and you have become engrossed in Maya.

ZUYD: One who comes to know the One Lord, by Guru's Grace, is carried across in an instant. ||11||
He, who by Guru's grace knows the One Lord, crosses the world ocean in a moment.
H7MP: Wawa: Your turn has come, you fool, but you have forgotten the Lord of Light.

D1XF: This opportunity shall not come again, you fool; you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||12||
This opportunity you shall not get again. You shall fall in the power of Death's myrmidons, O fool.
VH7L: Jhajha: You shall never have to regret and repent, you fool, if you listen to the Teachings of the True Guru, for even an instant.

ZFMW: Without the True Guru, there is no Guru at all; one who is without a Guru has a bad reputation. ||13||
Without the True Guru, there is not another Guru, and the one without the Guru has a bad name.
29FE: Dhadha: Restrain your wandering mind, you fool; deep within you the treasure is to be found.

3AH8: When one becomes Gurmukh, then he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; throughout the ages, he continues to drink it in. ||14||

G94P: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart, you fool, and all your past sins shall be forgiven. ||15||
Guru's feet abide you in your mind, O stupid person. All yours past sins, he shall forgive.
7845: Haha: Understand the Lord's Sermon, you fool; only then shall you attain eternal peace.

DQ8T: Rarra: Center your consciousness on the Lord, you fool; abide with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord.
R:-- O fool, remember you the Lord, through the persons in whose heart He is abiding.
0H3A: By Guru's Grace, those who recognize the Lord, understand the absolute Lord. ||17||
By Guru's grace they, who recognise the Lord, they understand their Absolute God.
J29R: Your limits cannot be known; the indescribable Lord cannot be described.
My Master, Yours limit cannot be known. The Indescribable God cannot be described.
Z0HM: O Nanak, whose who have met the True Guru, have their accounts settled. ||18||1||2||
Nanak, they whom the True Guru meets have their account settled.
ZSBX: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, First House:
KU3X: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
WT5L: O beautiful young bride, my Beloved Lord is very playful.
O bride with girl's youth, my Beloved is very sportive.
183W: When the bride enshrines great love for her Husband Lord, He becomes merciful, and loves her in return.
When the bride entertains great affection for her Groom, the Merciful Lord is delighted, and begins to love her.

0RV0: The soul-bride meets her Husband Lord, when the Lord Master Himself showers His favor upon her.
The wife meets her Spouse, if the Lord Master Himself shows her favour.
3XQW: Her bed is decorated in the company of her Beloved, and her seven pools are filled with ambrosial nectar.
Her couch is adorned in the association of her Beloved, and her Lord Master Himself shows her favour.
37YM: Be kind and compassionate to me, O Merciful True Lord, that I may obtain the Word of the Shabad, and sing Your Glorious Praises.
Show me Kindness and compassion, O Merciful True Lord, that I may obtain Guru's instruction, and sing Your praise.
GYNG: O Nanak, gazing upon her Husband Lord, the soul-bride is delighted, and her mind is filled with joy. ||1||
Nanak seeing God, her Husband, the wife is delighted, and there is joy in her mind.
B9RQ: O bride of natural beauty, offer your loving prayers to the Lord.
O bride with natural beauty, make an affectionate supplication, before your Lord.
6M0V: The Lord is pleasing to my mind and body; I am intoxicated in my Lord God's Company.
To my soul and body, God is pleasing and I am enamoured of Lord Master's association.
0JP1: Imbued with the Love of God, I pray to the Lord, and through the Lord's Name, I abide in peace.
Imbued with Lord's love. I pray before God, and through God's Name I abide in peace.
57V0: If you recognize His Glorious Virtues, then you shall come to know God; thus virtue shall dwell in you, and sin shall run away.
If you knowest His virtues, then shall you know the Lord and like this, merits shall abide in you and demerits shall flee away.
TXU5: Without You, I cannot survive, even for an instant; by merely talking and listening about You, I am not satisfied.
Without You I cannot remain even for a trice. By merely saying and hearing of You I am not satisfied.
QUTN: Nanak proclaims, "O Beloved, O Beloved!" His tongue and mind are drenched with the Lord's sublime essence. ||2||
Nanak cries forth, "O Beloved, O my Beloved". His tongue and mind are drenched with Lord's Nectar.
A9H9: O my companions and friends, my Husband Lord is the merchant.
O my companions and friends, my Beloved is a merchant.
DGC9: I have purchased the Lord's Name; its sweetness and value are unlimited.
God's Name I have purchased from Him. Its sweetness and value are infinite.
PJEB: His value is invaluable; the Beloved dwells in His true home. If it is pleasing to God, then He blesses His bride.
Invaluable is His worth and dwells He in the True Mansion. If the bride becomes pleasing to the darling Lord, then is she rendered illustrious.
Y0T9: Some enjoy sweet pleasures with the Lord, while I stand crying at His door.
Some enjoy dalliance with God, while I cry standing at His door.
BLG8: The Creator, the Cause of causes, the All-powerful Lord Himself arranges our affairs.
The Doer of works and the Omnipotent Lord of wealth Himself adjusts the affairs.
83LX: O Nanak, blessed is the soul-bride, upon whom He casts His Glance of Grace; she enshrines the Word of the Shabad in her heart. ||3||
Nanak, blessed is the bride on whom is the Lord's grace and in her heart she treasures up the Name.
4C42: In my home, the true songs of rejoicing resound; the Lord God, my Friend, has come to me.
In my home is the true song of rejoicing. The Lord, my friend, has visited me.
PLGW: He enjoys me, and imbued with His Love, I have captivated His heart, and given mine to Him.
Imbued with love, Lord enjoys me, I have captivated his heart and given mine to Him.
D0KB: I gave my mind, and obtained the Lord as my Husband; as it pleases His Will, He enjoys me.
I tendered my soul and got God as my Groom. As He pleases so does enjoy me.
9BKD: I have placed my body and mind before my Husband Lord, and through the Shabad, I have been blessed. Within the home of my own self, I have obtained the ambrosial fruit.
I have placed me body and soul before the Beloved, and through the Name have become very fortunate. Within my home I have attained the ambrosial fruit.
UVJ9: He is not obtained by intellectual recitation or great cleverness; only by love does the mind obtain Him.
Through intellect recitation and great cleverness the Lord is not obtained. What the soul desires is attained by love.
E5ZM: O Nanak, the Lord Master is my Best Friend; I am not an ordinary person. ||4||1||
Nanak, the Lord is my friend I am not an ordained person.
FNTB: The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds with the vibrations of the celestial instruments.
Divine music and the Divine music plays to the accompaniment of the air of the musical instruments.
BPK4: My mind, my mind is imbued with the Love of my Darling Beloved.
My soul and my soul is imbued with the love of my Darling Beloved.
ZLQN: Night and day, my detached mind remains absorbed in the Lord, and I obtain my home in the profound trance of the celestial void.
The detached soul, night and day remains absorbed in one God, and obtains an abode in the realm of profound trance.
GH5E: The True Guru has revealed to me the Primal Lord, the Infinite, my Beloved, the Unseen.
The True Guru has shown me the limitless, Unseen and the darling Primal Lord.
CUB8: The Lord's posture and His seat are permanent; my mind is absorbed in reflective contemplation upon Him.
My Lord's sitting place is permanent, and in His meditation my soul is absorbed.
VUKM: O Nanak, the detached ones are imbued with His Name, the unstruck melody, and the celestial vibrations. ||1||
Nanak, the desireless are tinged with the Name and hear the melodious celestial strain.
68K7: Tell me, how can I reach that unreachable, that unreachable city?
Say in what way can I reach that Unreachable, that Unreachable city of the Lord?
SS58: By practicing truthfulness and self-restraint, by contemplating His Glorious Virtues, and living the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
By practising truth, and self-restraint contemplating over Lord's praises and acting up to Guru's teaching.
BTQD: Practicing the True Word of the Shabad, one comes to the home of his own inner being, and obtains the treasure of virtue.
By practising the True Name, man gets to his own home, and obtains the Treasure of merits.
7947: He has no stems, roots, leaves or branches, but He is the Supreme Lord over the heads of all.
He has no stem, roots leaves and branches and is the Supreme Lord over the heads of all.
1S9C: Practicing intensive meditation, chanting and self-discipline, people have grown weary; stubbornly practicing these rituals, they still have not found Him.
Men have grown weary of practising worship, penances and self-discipline. They obtain Him not through these persistent rituals.
1Z99: O Nanak, through spiritual wisdom, the Lord, the Life of the world, is met; the True Guru imparts this understanding. ||2||
Nanak, through Divine Knowledge, Lord the Life of the world, is met. The True Guru imparts this understanding.
W7AH: The Guru is the ocean, the mountain of jewels, overflowing with jewels.
The Guru is the mine of jewels and an ocean, which abounds in pearls.

1DWJ: Take your bath in the seven seas, O my mind, and become pure.
Take you bath in the seven seas, O my soul and become pure.
6G2Z: Renouncing sexual desire, anger, deceit and corruption, he enshrines the True Name in his heart.
Renouncing lust, wrath, deceit and mortal sins he clasps the True Name to his heart.
BRBC: When the waves of ego, greed and avarice subside, he finds the Lord Master, Merciful to the meek.
When the currents of ego, avarice and greed die away, the man meets the Master, who is merciful to the meek.
P2GK: O Nanak, there is no place of pilgrimage comparable to the Guru; the True Guru is the Lord of the world. ||3||
Nanak, at par with the Guru, there is no place of pilgrimage. The True Guru is himself the world Cherisher Lord.
6XAM: I have searched the jungles and forests, and looked upon all the fields.
I have searched the jungles and forests, and have seen all the grass blades.
V05A: You created the three worlds, the entire universe, everything.
The three worlds, all the sentient beings, and the entire universe you have created, O Lord.
2D1U: You created everything; You alone are permanent. Nothing is equal to You.
All the created by You, You alone are ever stable. None is equal to you.
NK1E: You are the Giver - all are Your beggars; without You, who should we praise?
You are the Giver and all others are Yours beggars, and without You whom else should I praise?
EAYA: You bestow Your gifts, even when we do not ask for them, O Great Giver; devotion to You is a treasure over-flowing.
My Donor, You givest unasked for gifts, and brimful are the treasure of Yours meditation.
CK68: Without the Lord's Name, there is no liberation; so says Nanak, the meek. ||4||2||
Without the Lord's Name, man is not emancipated. So says, Nanak the meek.
5TAC: My mind, my mind is attuned to the Love of my Beloved Lord.
My soul, my soul is imbued with the love of my Beloved Lord Master.
TQZ2: The True Lord Master, the Primal Being, the Infinite One, is the Support of the earth.
True and infinite is the primal Lord Master, who is sustaining the earth.
48JW: He is unfathomable, unapproachable, infinite and incomparable. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Lord above all.
The Unapproachable, Incomprehensible limitless and peerless Supreme Master is the Over-Lord of all.
NKXD: He is the Lord, from the beginning, throughout the ages, now and forevermore; know that all else is false.
The Primal Lord was in the beginning of ages, is now and shall also be. Deem all else as false.
QWQM: If one does not appreciate the value of good deeds and Dharmic faith, how can one obtain clarity of consciousness and liberation?
One knows not the worth of virtuous deeds and piety; how can one obtain high understanding and salvation?
BZSR: O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Word of the Shabad; night and day, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Nanak, the pious person knows only the Lord, and day and night meditates on His Name.
8L5C: My mind, my mind has come to accept, that the Naam is our only Friend.
My soul, my soul has come to believe, that Lord's Name alone is Name's succour.
DPMM: Egotism, worldly attachment, and the lures of Maya shall not go with you.
Egotism, worldly attachment and wealth go not with him, O Lord.
RXR8: Mother, father, famliy, children, cleverness, property and spouses - none of these shall go with you.
Mother, father brother, son, cleverness, property and wife keep not his company.
J18F: I have renounced Maya, the daughter of the ocean; reflecting upon reality, I have trampled it under my feet.
Through Lord's meditation, I have abandoned and forsaken wealth, the daughter of ocean, and have trampled it under my feet.
REY4: The Primal Lord has revealed this wondrous show; wherever I look, there I see Him.
The primal Lord has shown a wondrous show, that whatever I behold, there I find him.
3AZQ: O Nanak, I shall not forsake the Lord's devotional worship; in the natural course, what shall be, shall be. ||2||
Nanak, forsake I not Lord's devotional service. In the natural course, come what may.
0X9K: My mind, my mind has become immaculately pure, contemplating the True Lord.
My mind, my mind has become immaculate by contemplating over the True Lord.
2U5U: I have dispelled my vices, and now I walk in the company of the virtuous.
Vices I have effaced (dispelled), and I now walk with the company of the good.
098C: Discarding my vices, I do good deeds, and in the True Court, I am judged as true.
Discarding vices I do good deeds, and am exonerated in the True court.
E1XU: My coming and going has come to an end; as Gurmukh, I reflect upon the nature of reality.
My coming and going are stopped and stayed. For I, through the Guru, have reflected on the Real Thing.
E2V7: O my Dear Friend, You are my all-knowing companion; grant me the glory of Your True Name.
My Master, You are, my intimate friend and wise comrade. Grant me the glory of Your True Name.
DGNF: O Nanak, the jewel of the Naam has been revealed to me; such are the Teachings I have received from the Guru. ||3||
Nanak, I have received such an instruction from the Guru, that the Name jewel is revealed to me.
HE5J: I have carefully applied the healing ointment to my eyes, and I am attuned to the Immaculate Lord.
Collyrium, the collyrium of truth, I have carefully applied to my eyes, and am imbued with the Immaculate Lord.
V9LQ: He is permeating my mind and body, the Life of the world, the Lord, the Great Giver.
Within my mind and body is contained the Bestower Lord, the life of the world.
MVVU: My mind is imbued with the Lord, the Great Giver, the Life of the world; I have merged and blended with Him, with intuitive ease.
My soul is imbued with the beneficient God, the life of the world, and is easily united and blended with Him.
GSYK: In the Company of the Holy, and the Saints' Society, by God's Grace, peace is obtained.
By Lord's grace, man obtains peace in the saints society and the association of the holy-men.
V3RQ: The renunciates remain absorbed in devotional worship to the Lord; they are rid of emotional attachment and desire.
The world denouncers remain absorbed in God's worship and are rid of attachment and desire.
40NT: O Nanak, how rare is that unattached servant, who conquers his ego, and remains pleased with the Lord. ||4||3||
Nanak, rare is the desireless slave of God. Who by quelling his ego remains pleased with the Lord.

ESJN: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, Second House:
V1MB: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace He is attainted.
09Y1: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord.
You are the Giver of all the places, where ever I go, O my True Creator
HYZ6: You are the Giver of all, the Architect of Destiny, the Dispeller of distress.
You are the Giver of all the Architect of destiny and the Distress Dispeller.
5HG8: The Lord Master is the Dispeller of distress; all that happens is by His doing.
Destroyer of pain is the Lord, and, all that takes place is of His doing.
M2AT: Millions upon millions of sins, He destroys in an instant.
Millions upon millions of sins, He destroyer in a moment.
40V5: He calls a swan a swan, and a crane a crane; He contemplates each and every heart.
You assayest every heart, and declarest a swan, a swan and a crane a crane.
8C6R: You are everywhere, wherever I go, O True Creator Lord. ||1||
You are at all the places, wherever I go, O my True Creator.
X2C4: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world.
They who remember God with single mind, attain peace, but rare are they in the world.
FSLP: The Messenger of Death does not draw near those who live the Guru's Teachings; they never return defeated.
Death's courier not near them, they act up to Guru's instruction, and they never return routed.
7GL7: Those who appreciate the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, never suffer defeat; the Messenger of Death does not even approach them.
They, who dwell upon Lord God's excellence suffer not defeat ever, Death myrmidon goes not near them.
YZ16: Birth and death are ended for those who are attached to the feet of the Lord.
Ended are the births and deaths of those, who are attached with God's feet,
8ZSZ: Through the Guru's Teachings, they obtain the sublime essence of the Lord, and the fruit of the Lord; they enshrine the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their hearts.
By Guru's teaching, they obtain God's elixir and God's Fruit and Lord God's Name, they clasp to their heart.
7VTY: Those who meditate on Him single-mindedly obtain peace; how rare are they in this world. ||2||
They who think of the Lord with single mind, obtain joys, but a few are they in this world.
3HTE: He who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - to Him I am a sacrifice.
He who created the beings and has put them to task, To Him I am a sacrifice.
UZGA: So serve Him, and gather profit, and you shall obtain honor in the Court of the Lord.
Perform His service, gather profit and thus you obtain honour in God's Court.
W4EP: That humble being, who recognizes the One Lord alone, obtains honor in the Court of the Lord.
The man, who recognises but One God, that man alone gathers honour in God's Court.
KM0K: One who meditates on the Lord, through the Guru's Teachings, obtains the nine treasures; he chants and repeats continually the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
He, who under Guru's instruction, remember God and ever utters and repeats God's praise, obtain to the Nine treasure.
CD8W: Day and night, take the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the most sublime Primal Being.
Day and night take you the Name of the God, who is sublime and the Lord president of all.
2AY0: The One who created the world and assigned all to their tasks - I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||
I am a sacrifice to Him, who having created the world, has put it to work.
AZJ3: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life.
They who repeat the Name look embellished and obtain the fruit of peace. They who believe in the Name win the life's game.
563X: Their blessings are not exhausted, if it pleases the Lord, even though numerous ages may pass.
If it pleases Him, they run not short of Lord's boons, even through series of ages may pass.
MJJX: Even though numerous ages may pass, O Lord Master, their blessings are not exhausted.
Though several ages may pass away to their boons there, is no end, O Lord.
5695: They do not age, they do not die and fall into hell, if they meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
They age not, die not and fall not into hell, only if they meditate on God's Name.
8PK2: Those who chant the Lord's Name, Har, Har, do not wither, O Nanak; they are not afflicted by pain.
They who utter God's Name, wither not and, O Nanak, nor do they suffer pain.
C44X: Those who chant the Naam look beautiful; they obtain the fruit of peace. Those who believe in the Name win the game of life. ||4||1||4||
They who take the Name, look beauteous and reap the fruit of happiness. They who accept the Name, win the life game.
DEAK: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
L6DG: Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, Third House:
X5HR: Listen, O black deer: why are you so attached to the orchard of passion?
Hear you, O black, why are you enamoured of the orchard (of passion)?
HTS8: The fruit of sin is sweet for only a few days, and then it grows hot and bitter.
The fruit of sin is sweet for but four days. It then grows hot (unsavory).
FWUQ: That fruit which intoxicated you has now become bitter and painful, without the Naam.
Then the fruit, which you greatly longest for, becomes bitter, nay rather very bitter, without the Name.

LKJL: It is temporary, like the waves on the sea, and the flash of lightning.
That fruit is transitory, like the sea-risen ripples and like lightning's flash.
PNT9: Without the Lord, there is no other protector, but you have forgotten Him.
Without God, there is no other protector and Him you have forgotten.
6TGX: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O black deer. ||1||
Nanak tells the truth, think of it, O man. You shall die, O black deer.
K6U8: O bumble bee, you wander among the flowers, but terrible pain awaits you.
O bumble bee, you wanderest among the flowers. Exceedingly great calamity shall befall you.
3NGA: I have asked my Guru for true understanding.
I have inquired of my Guru regarding the true comprehension.
MULV: I have asked my True Guru for understanding about the bumble bee, who is so involved with the flowers of the garden.
O bumble-bee, mad after the creepers flowers, I have asked my True Guru, regarding the knowledge of the Lord.
2PZF: When the sun rises, the body will fall, and it will be cooked in hot oil.
When the sun rises (after the night of life is ever), the body falls and the soul is boiled in hot oil.
3GT8: You shall be bound and beaten on the road of Death, without the Word of the Shabad, O madman.
O demon, without God's Name you shall be bound and suffer strokes on the road of Death.
D0UT: Nanak speaks the Truth. Reflect upon it, O mind; you shall die, O bumble bee. ||2||
Truly says Nanak, contemplate over the Lord, O my soul, as you shall die, O honey-bee.
360V: O my stranger soul, why do you fall into entanglements?
O my strange soul! why fallest you into entanglements?
XG4R: The True Lord abides within your mind; why are you trapped by the noose of Death?
When the True Lord abides within your mind, why shouldest you be entrapped in Death's noose?
DG8B: The fish leaves the water with tearful eyes, when the fisherman casts his net.
The fisherman casts his net, the fish leaves the water with tearful eyes.
KGG5: The love of Maya is sweet to the world, but in the end, this delusion is dispelled.
To the world love of worldly (wealth) is sweet, but this delusion is set aside in the end.
61ZU: So perform devotional worship, link your consciousness to the Lord, and dispel anxiety from your mind.
Serve your God, attach your mind with God and dispel yours mental anxieties.
ZLUE: Nanak speaks the Truth; focus your consciousness on the Lord, O my stranger soul. ||3||
Nanak tells the truth, meditate you on the Lord in your mind, O my stranger soul.
6UUL: The rivers and streams which separate may sometime be united again.
The river courses which separate, do meet again perchance.
SG99: In age after age, that which is sweet, is full of poison; how rare is the Yogi who understands this.
In every age, what is sweet is full of poison. Some rare renouncer understands this.
K7TZ: That rare person who centers his consciousness on the True Guru, knows intuitively and realizes the Lord.
Some rare person who thinks of the True Guru, knows Divine Knowledge and realises God.
26ZP: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the thoughtless fools wander in doubt, and are ruined.
Without God's Name, the thoughtless fools stray in superstition and are ruined.
ABJB: Those whose hearts are not touched by devotional worship and the Name of the True Lord, shall weep and wail loudly in the end.
They whose mind contains not God's True Name and devotion, bewail loudly in the end.
0DZW: Nanak speaks the Truth; through the True Word of the Shabad, those long separated from the Lord, are united once again. ||4||1||5||
Nanak utters a truth, through the true Gurbani, the since long separated souls unite with the Lord.
V0RV: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By True Guru's grace He is obtained.
SA49: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, First House:
294V: Within my home, the true wedding songs of rejoicing are sung; my home is adorned with the True Word of the Shabad.
Within my home are sung the true songs of rejoicing, and with the Guru's True word my home is adorned.
W0QR: The soul-bride has met her Husband Lord; God Himself has consummated this union.
The bride has met her Groom and the Lord Master has Himself accomplished the union.
LGQY: God Himself has consummated this union; the soul-bride enshrines Truth within her mind, intoxicated with peaceful poise.
The bride is intoxicated with Divine Knowledge, as the True Name she has enshrined in her mind, and the Lord has united her with Himself.
T4UN: Embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and beautified with Truth, she enjoys her Beloved forever, imbued with His Love.
Embellished with Gurbani, beautiful with truth and tinctured in love, she ever enjoys her Beloved.
9HBS: Eradicating her ego, she obtains her Husband Lord, and then, the sublime essence of the Lord dwells within her mind.
Stilling her ego, she attains God, her Spouse and then God's elixir is embedded in her mind.
CLJQ: Says Nanak, fruitful and prosperous is her entire life; she is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
Says Nanak, fruitful is the entire life of her, who is bedecked with Guru's hymns.
LU3U: The soul-bride who has been led astray by duality and doubt, does not attain her Husband Lord.
The damsel, who is gone astray in duality and double, attains not God her Groom.
ZVPZ: That soul-bride has no virtue, and she wastes her life in vain.
The wife has no merit, so she vainly losses her life, O Lord.
R881: The self-willed, ignorant and disgraceful manmukh wastes her life in vain, and in the end, she comes to grief.
The self-willed ignorant and impious woman wastes her life in vain and ultimately repents.
86RL: But when she serves her True Guru, she obtains peace, and then she meets her Husband Lord, face to face.
When she serves her True Guru, she receives eternal peace and then her Beloved meets her face to face.
0F8H: Beholding her Husband Lord, she blossoms forth; her heart is delighted, and she is beautified by the True Word of the Shabad.
Beholding her Spouse she blooms forth, her heart is delighted and she is beautiful with the True Name.
JPBR: O Nanak, without the Name, the soul-bride wanders around, deluded by doubt. Meeting her Beloved, she obtains peace. ||2||
Nanak, without the Name, the bride strays in suspicious and meeting her Spouse, she obtains peace.

J866: The soul-bride knows that her Husband Lord is with her; the Guru unites her in this union.
The wife, whom the Guru unites with the society of saints, knows her Groom to be with her, O Lord.
A5SR: Within her heart, she is merged with the Shabad, and the fire of her desire is easily extinguished.
Her heart is united with the Guru's hymns and her fire of desire is easily extinguished.
1BJG: The Shabad has quenched the fire of desire, and within her heart, peace and tranquility have come; she tastes the Lord's essence with intuitive ease.
With God's Name, the fire was extinguished peace reigned within her and she easily tasted God's elixir.
3S47: Meeting her Beloved, she enjoys His Love continually, and her speech rings with the True Shabad.
Meeting her Beloved, she ever enjoys His love and thoroughly preaches the Guru's true hymns.
TKN2: Reading and studying continually, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary; wearing religious robes, liberation is not obtained.
By continual reading the scholars and silent sages are tired, and through religious garbs emancipation is not attained.
XY9X: O Nanak, without devotional worship, the world has gone insane; through the True Word of the Shabad, one meets the Lord. ||3||
Nanak, without love-worship the world is gone mad, through the True Gurbani the man meets the Lord.
EXFB: Bliss permeates the mind of the soul-bride, who meets her Beloved Lord.
Bliss reigns in the mind of the bride, whom reverend God, the Beloved meets.
XJUQ: The soul-bride is enraptured with the sublime essence of the Lord, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Through the Infinite words of the Guru, the bride is enraptured with God's ambrosia.
D8L3: Through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad, she meets her Beloved; she continually contemplates and enshrines His Glorious Virtues in her mind.
By means of the peerless? Gurbani, she meets her Beloved and she ever ponders on and enshrines His virtues in her mind.
JHLD: Her bed was adorned when she enjoyed her Husband Lord; meeting with her Beloved, her demerits were erased.
Her couch got bedecked when she enjoyed her Spouse and by meeting with her Love, her demerits fled away.
CARS: That house, within which the Lord's Name is continually meditated upon, resounds with the wedding songs of rejoicing, throughout the four ages.
Throughout the four ages, the wedding songs (songs of joy) are sung in the house, in which God's Name is ever meditated upon.
NPJN: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, we are in bliss forever; meeting the Lord, our affairs are resolved. ||4||1||6||
Nanak, tinctured with the Name, the mortal ever abides in happiness. By meeting God, the affairs get adjusted.
P20F: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but one God. By true Guru's grace. He is met.
EJ5J: Aasaa, Third Mehl, Chhant, Third House:
5X8U: O my beloved friend, dedicate yourself to the devotional worship of your Husband Lord.
O my friend and intimate, devote yourself to the meditation of Lord, the Spouse.
UM3N: Serve your Guru constantly, and obtain the wealth of the Naam.
Ever serve you your Guru and obtain the wealth of the Name.
Q31E: Dedicate yourself to the worship of your Husband Lord; this is pleasing to your Beloved Husband.
Perform you the service of the Master, which service is pleasing to he dear Groom.
7TCG: If you walk in accordance with your own will, then your Husband Lord will not be pleased with you.
If you walk according to your own will, then, the Spouse, shall not be pleased with you.
D5LY: This path of loving devotional worship is very difficult; how rare are those who find it, through the Gurdwara, the Guru's Gate.
This way of love worship is difficult, through the Guru some rare one finds it.
CAS1: Says Nanak, that one, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, links his consciousness to the worship of the Lord. ||1||
Says Nanak, he, to whom God shows mercy, attaches his mind to His meditation.
RZ14: O my detached mind, to whom do you show your detachment?
O my detached soul, whom showest you your indifference towards the world?
BN5R: So become detached, and renounce hypocrisy; Your Husband Lord knows everything.
Detach yourself from the world and shed your hypocrisy. He, the Lord knows everything.
QZ4A: The One Lord is pervading the water, the land and the sky; the Gurmukh realizes the Command of His Will.
The One Lord is pervading the ocean, desert, earth and the sky,
PGR5: Thus says Nanak: such a detached soul remains absorbed in the Lord's Love, day and night. ||2||
Thus says Nanak, such a solitarian, night and day, remains absorbed in God's love.
ADXX: Wherever you wander, O my mind, the Lord is there with you.
Wherever, you wanderest, O my mind, there the Lord is with you.
J4JX: Renounce your cleverness, O my mind, and reflect upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Shed you your cleverness, O my mind, and deliberate over the Guru's hymns.
X275: Your Husband Lord is always with you, if you remember the Lord's Name, even for an instant.
He, the Bridegroom is ever with you, even if you rememberest God's Name for a moment.
Z6ZA: The sins of countless incarnations shall be washed away, and in the end, you shall obtain the supreme status.
Your sins of many births shall be washed off, and in the end, you shall attain the supreme status.
HWSK: You shall be linked to the True Lord, and as Gurmukh, remember Him forever.
You shall patch up with the True Lord, by ever remembering Him through the Guru.
JM4Y: Thus says Nanak: wherever you go, O my mind, the Lord is there with you. ||3||
Thus, says Nanak, whatever you goes, O my mind, thither God is ever with you.
F7P8: Meeting the True Guru, the wandering mind is held steady; it comes to abide in its own home.
Meeting the True Guru, the wandering mind is held, and it comes and abides in its own home.
2GC8: It purchases the Naam, chants the Naam, and remains absorbed in the Naam.
It then purchases the Name, utters the Name and in the Name it remains absorbed.
